verdict.rationale: Chargebee offers webhooks, dunning/smart retry, and MCP servers that let AI clients access billing capabilities, which could underpin background automations, but there's no direct evidence of a scheduler or agent-orchestration feature that runs autonomous, unattended workflows over time. missing for 10: explicit autonomous/background automation or workflow engine documentation, evidence of scheduled/triggered agentic tasks, independent confirmation of unattended operation.
